integrity: An analytic all-orders proof is given and separately corroborated on W(2), W(3) by explicit finite free-face/coboundary checks; no claim of independent or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on existence of finite thick generalized quadrangle of order (s,t); unweighted shortest-path metric and inclusive distance threshold; not automorphism-equivariant; no classification of arbitrary girth-eight graphs or other polygons.
title: The complete graph-metric Rips homotopy filtration of finite generalized quadrangles
